style: Warm 2D storybook editorial illustration for a history-of-time documentary video: flat vector shapes with subtle paper grain, deep indigo night, warm amber dawn and brass gold palette with parchment cream accents, dramatic cinematic lighting, consistent character design, wide cinematic framing, clear separation between foreground and background planes so layers can move independently, NO text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no watermark, no logos, no UI elements.

shots.prompt: A wide landscape split between golden sunrise and deep indigo night, a lone human silhouette standing on a hill watching the sun move, a long shadow stretching behind, sense of time passing.

A rising arc across one wide frame telling the story of time: at the bottom a stone pillar with its shadow, higher water dripping into a vessel, then a candle with marks, then brass gears of a clock, near the top glowing quartz and floating circles of light, warm amber to deep indigo gradient.
A vast ancient stone circle monument under a starry sky, faint luminous golden arcs of the sun and moon rising from the stones, wonder and order, deep indigo and amber palette.
Ancient farmers in a wide field at dawn, watching the sun, one pointing at the horizon, sense of seasons and planting, warm amber light, deep green field.
A wide early settlement with fields and huts under a moving sky, sun and moon faintly both visible on the two sides, sense of day and night rhythm.
A human silhouette gazing up at a huge sky filled with sun, moon and stars, awe and wonder, warm amber and deep indigo palette.
A massive ancient stone monument aligned with the sunrise, first golden ray striking a carved stone, starry sky fading, deep indigo and amber.
Ancient stone circle with standing stones at dusk, faint concentric arcs of sun and moon paths drawn in luminous light overhead.
A wide desert horizon with ancient carved stone calendar marks under a huge rotating sky of stars, sense of counting the years.
A tall stone pillar standing in sand, its long shadow stretching across the ground toward marked stones, bright amber sun, sense of the first sundial.
An ancient sundial stone with carved lines and a moving shadow, close cinematic light, brass and parchment tones.
A wide ancient plaza with several obelisks casting shadows, people glancing at them to read the hour, warm amber morning, deep indigo shadows.
A stone vessel with a thin stream of water dripping through a small hole into a lower bowl, water level marks, close cinematic light, brass and cream tones.
An ancient water clock vessel with carved level lines, a slow drip, deep shadows and a single warm light source, mysterious mood.
A wide ancient hall with people waiting around a water clock, torches, sense of measuring time at night, warm amber and deep indigo.
A slow-burning candle divided into marked segments on a stand in a dark temple, warm glow, sense of hours measured by fire.
A glass hourglass with sand flowing from the top to the bottom chamber, close cinematic light, brass frame, parchment background.
A wide ancient workshop with hanging marked cords, a lit brazier and an hourglass on a table, sense of many ways to measure time, warm amber and deep indigo.
A medieval monastery tower at dawn with a large clock face, monks walking below, warm amber light, deep indigo sky, sense of time calling people to prayer.
Close view of heavy brass gears, weights and an iron chain turning inside an ancient mechanical clock, dramatic warm light, deep shadows.
A wide stone monastery courtyard with a great clock tower casting a long shadow, people gathering, warm amber and deep indigo palette.
A pocket watch with coiled spring held in a hand against a deep indigo background, warm brass glow, sense of time carried in a pocket.
A great city tower clock face with large hands over a busy medieval square, people looking up, warm amber light, deep indigo shadows.
A wide medieval street with shopkeepers and townsfolk moving under a tall clock tower, sense of one shared rhythm, warm amber and deep indigo.
A pendulum swinging on a long cord inside a tall wooden clock case, motion blur arcs, dramatic warm light, deep shadows, sense of regular beat.
Close view of a brass pendulum clock face with fine minute and second marks, warm glow, parchment background, sense of precision.
A wide elegant cabinet with a tall grandfather clock and a swinging pendulum, a scholar watching it, warm amber and deep indigo palette.
An old sailing ship on a wide ocean at night, a navigator with a brass chronometer and a star chart, sense of finding the way home by time.
Close view of a brass marine chronometer on a wooden table with faded sea charts and a compass, warm lantern light, deep indigo shadows.
A wide stormy sea with a sailing ship guided by stars, faint luminous time-and-space lines across the sky, deep indigo and amber palette.
A wristwatch on an arm with a tiny quartz crystal glowing faintly inside, close cinematic light, warm amber and deep indigo.
A mass of ordinary wristwatches on a table, one lit warmly among the crowd, sense of time becoming personal and cheap, parchment and brass tones.
A wide modern city street full of people each glancing at watches and phones, warm amber light, deep indigo shadows, sense of one shared rhythm.
A glowing hydrogen-like atom with electron orbits rendered as luminous rings, close cinematic view, deep indigo background, amber and cyan glow, sense of the most precise clock.
Abstract concentric waves radiating from a single bright point, like atomic oscillations, deep indigo background, amber and cyan glow, sense of exact timekeeping.
A satellite in orbit above the Earth, beams of light synchronizing clocks on the ground below, deep indigo space, amber and cyan glow.
A glowing data network of light lines and nodes pulsing at a regular beat, abstract, deep indigo background, amber and cyan glow, sense of synchronized time.
A wide split scene: on one side an ancient stone shadow pillar, on the other a modern glowing network of clocks, luminous line connecting them, deep indigo and amber palette.
